planets.name: TOI-2267 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2267 A with a 2.29-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-2267 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around TOI-2267 A. Its orbit and size follow Zúñiga-Fernández et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
